title: Height difference in a polynomial presentation after field extension

from.place: step 7: essential-surjectivity paragraphs, dimension comparison in the smooth/local-complete-intersection argument; realized here by steps 1–4 of Tag 00P4

statement: Let k and K be fields, S a commutative k-algebra, and f : k[x_1,…,x_n] → S a surjective k-algebra map [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring; def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. There exists a surjective ring map g : K[x_1,…,x_n] → S ⊗[k] K such that for every prime Q of S ⊗[k] K, with q its contraction to S, height(f⁻¹(q)) + height(Q) = height(g⁻¹(Q)) + height(q). The proof constructs g by scalar extension of f.

proof.text: Construct the base-changed polynomial map by the tensor-product map and the canonical polynomial/tensor-product ring equivalence. Right exactness gives surjectivity and identifies its kernel with the extension of the original kernel. The square commutes on coefficients and variables. Use Algebra.TensorProduct.map_surjective, MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv, and Algebra.TensorProduct.rTensor_ker directly; Algebra.Presentation.baseChange is not invoked.

The two quotient rings by the extended prime ideals are isomorphic, carrying the induced primes to one another, so their heights agree by RingEquiv.height_map. Both vertical maps are flat and all rings are Noetherian; apply Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown to both maps and reassociate addition. Flatness is inferred from Module.Flat tensor-product stability over a field, via RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff; faithful flatness is not needed. Noetherianity uses polynomial-ring instances, Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing, and isNoetherianRing_of_surjective.

theorem polynomial_presentation_height_field_extension
    {k : Type u} {K : Type v} {S : Type w} [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k K] [Algebra k S] (n : ℕ)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] S) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) K →+* (S ⊗[k] K), Function.Surjective g ∧
      ∀ Q : PrimeSpectrum (S ⊗[k] K),
        let q := PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := k) (A := S) (B := K)) Q
        (q.asIdeal.comap f.toRingHom).height + Q.asIdeal.height =
          (Q.asIdeal.comap g).height + q.asIdeal.height
